brief.claim: Using 12 country-level indicators, the model identifies which country-years will see a civil war onset, with AUC of at least 0.75 in new country-years.

data_keys.meaning: indicator values, one row per country-year; entries flagged as unobserved hold 0
True where the indicator was recorded
True if a civil war began in that country-year

brief.sizes: 250 country-years, 12 indicators, about 15% onsets and about 20% of entries unobserved.
